scientific_change_from_v2: replace cross-classifier raw-logit subtraction with separately calibrated probability-product routes and a frozen confidence dead zone; fit independent directional experts; select exactly one site by direct held behavior; require true downstream A/B margin-gradient evidence; prohibit naive independent multi-site stacking

failure_diagnosis.router: V2 subtracts raw scores from independently trained history and task classifiers; their scales and offsets are not commensurate, so all three sites saturate at absolute factor approximately one on every matched and mismatched cell
failure_diagnosis.multisite: each V2 site independently reconstructs a complete baseline-to-teacher delta, but inference applies sites 23, 27, and 31 serially; later editors therefore receive inputs shifted away from their baseline capture distribution and can repeat or conflict with earlier correction
failure_diagnosis.proxy: V2 selects by matched-teacher activation MSE plus a same-site linear margin probe; all fit directions and label swaps improve under this proxy while terminal downstream behavior reverses in one direction and one label orbit
failure_diagnosis.direction_sharing: V2 forces both causal directions through one conditioner and one output map with a signed scalar, an untested inverse-symmetry assumption contradicted by terminal directional and label-swap asymmetry
failure_diagnosis.aggregate_gate: V2 averages protected correction across sites; layer 31 exceeded its own 0.02 reference at 0.02087346464395523 while the aggregate gate still passed

router.calibration_scope: each head separately on fit calibration fold 6; positive affine rescaling of a raw head and its calibration is route invariant
router.matched_and_ambiguous_semantics: both routes exactly zero; return the original activation without conversion or addition

architecture.history_head: linear logistic head over normalized full task-boundary hidden state
architecture.task_head: linear logistic head over normalized full current-task site input
architecture.directional_experts: two independent LayerNorm-MLP correction experts with independent rank-16 protected-residualized task-margin-gradient output bases
architecture.output_basis_source: for each direction and site, uncentered PCA of row-L2-normalized true task-aligned margin gradients on fit train folds followed by removal of the frozen protected-state rank-32 subspace; teacher activation deltas are forbidden as the primary output-basis source
architecture.expert_input: 16 boundary coordinates, 32 current-input coordinates, two calibrated probabilities, and two structural route values
architecture.edit_equation: edited = original + external_gate * clipped(positive_route * positive_expert + negative_route * negative_expert)
architecture.multisite_extension_requirement: a later contract may add one residual site only after recapturing that site's inputs and downstream gradients with the selected earlier editor active

per_row_targets: gradient of task-aligned A/B margin with respect to each candidate component output at the last decision token

head_calibration_fit_then_frozen.method: separate affine Platt scaling per head on fold 6

optimization.primary_loss: one-sided hinge on true downstream first-order gain: gradient_task_margin dot correction must recover a positive clipped fraction of the matched-counterfactual margin gap
optimization.label_swap_orbit_loss: penalize differences in true first-order gain between paired label swaps; label identity is never an editor input
optimization.protected_loss: maximum across positive-forced and negative-forced mean squared relative correction on the frozen protected capture, using direction-consistent canonical probabilities and route bits; structural-router abstention cannot hide expert magnitude
optimization.matched_preservation_reason: matched preservation is structural through the exact-zero router, not delegated to a soft loss

fit_gates_per_candidate_without_cross_si.protected_forced_on_gate_aggregation: maximum of the two per-direction mean relative corrections

selection_order: largest lower 95 percent bound on gap reduction
smallest matched binary KL upper bound
direct_behavior_site_selection.if_no_candidate_passes: stop after all three direct behavior evaluations and retain a complete falsifier; do not combine sites or weaken gates

developmental_operator_dev_gate.interpretation: developmental because V2 terminal operator_dev results informed V3 design
